Total weight of flagstones = 80 × 75 = 6000 pounds.
Capacity per truck = 2000 pounds.
Weight-equivalent truck loads = 6000 ÷ 2000 = 3.

Trucks needed for 80 intact stones = ceil(80 ÷ 26) = ceil(3.07) = 4 trucks.
Pure weight division is 3 loads, practical requirement is 4 trucks.

To lose 8 pounds at 0.5 pounds per week, Sandy needs $8 / 0.5 = 16$ weeks.
